# LivePlan

> > LivePlan is an AI-powered business planning and financial forecasting platform that helps small businesses create plans, track performance, and secure funding.

LivePlan provides comprehensive business planning software with real-time financial dashboards, AI-assisted writing, cash flow forecasting, and integrations with accounting tools like QuickBooks and Xero. The platform is designed for startups, small businesses, and entrepreneurs seeking to validate ideas, plan growth, and present to investors.

## Planning & Forecasting Tools

- [Business Plan Builder](https://www.liveplan.com/features/business-plan-builder): LivePlan's business plan builder: AI-powered assistance, expert guidance, automatic financials.
- [Financial Forecasts & Scenarios](https://www.liveplan.com/features/financial-forecasts-and-scenarios): LivePlan financial forecasting: cash flow analysis, what-if scenarios, strategic decision-making.
- [Cash Flow Forecasting Software](https://www.liveplan.com/features/cash-flow-forecast): LivePlan cash flow forecasting: predict cash flow, profits, and plan contingencies accurately.
- [Build Your Business Budget](https://www.liveplan.com/features/business-budgeting): LivePlan budgeting: guided process, AI categories, accounting sync, performance tracking.
- [Market Research](https://www.liveplan.com/features/market-research): LivePlan market research: AI-powered insights on market size, competitors, and customers.
